SELECT DISTINCT hbm.BP_CODE AS bp_code, hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_name AS bp_id_n, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE' AND scv.VALUE = pb.bp_type ) bp_type_n, hbm.bp_class, (select hbt.description from hls_business_type hbt where hbm.bp_class = hbt.business_type AND hbt.document_category = 'HLS_BP_MASTER') bp_class_n, hbm.economic_indu_classify, (select hsc.description from hls_stat_class hsc where to_char(hsc.class_id) = to_char(hbm.economic_indu_classify) and hsc.enabled_flag = 'Y') economic_indu_classify_n, hbm.GROUP_COMPANIES, HBM.industry, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'INDUSTRY_ORG' and v.code_value=HBM.industry) industry_n,hbm.credit_grade, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'RSC_CREDIT_RATING' AND scv.VALUE = to_char(hbm.credit_grade) ) credit_grade_n FROM prj_project_bp pb left join hls_bp_master hbm on pb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id
pb.project_id in ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.project_id FROM PRJ_CHECK c,PRJ_PROJECT p,PRJ_PROJECT p2 where p.project_id = c.contract_id and p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and c.check_id = #{checkId})

select ppb.project_id, ppb.prj_bp_id, hli.lease_item_id, hli.full_name lease_item_id_n, hli.lease_item_code, hli.lease_item_type, (select scvb.meaning as value_name from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code = 'HLS.COLLATERAL_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = hli.lease_item_type) lease_item_type_n, hli.pattern, (select scvb.meaning as value_name from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scb.code = (case when hli.lease_item_type ='MORTGAGE' then 'HLS.MORTGAGE_TYPE' else 'HLS.PLEDGE_TYPE' end) and scvb.value = hli.pattern) pattern_n, hli.regulatory_asset_class, (select t.description value_name from hls_business_type t where t.document_category = 'REGULATORY_ASSET_CLASS' and t.business_type = hli.regulatory_asset_class) regulatory_asset_class_n, hli.regulatory_asset_class_sub, (select t.description value_name from hls_document_type t where t.document_category = 'REGULATORY_ASSET_CLASS' and t.business_type = hli.regulatory_asset_class and t.document_type = hli.regulatory_asset_class_sub) regulatory_asset_class_sub_n, hli.mortgagor, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = hli.MORTGAGOR) mortgagor_n, hli.valuation_date valuation_date, hli.valuation_unit, (select a.EVALUATION_VALUE from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.EVALUATION_VALUE) as evaluation_value from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) asset_value_total, (select a.MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT) as MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) mortgage_amount_total, (SELECT nvl(sum(hlid.net_asset_value),0) FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid where hlid.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id ) net_asset_value_total, (select h.excel_id from hls_web_excel h where h.enabled_flag = 'Y' and h.excel_type = 'MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_REPORT') as excel_id,
(SELECT max(hr.result_id) FROM hls_web_excel_calc_result hr, hls_web_excel hwe where hr.source_document_id = hli.lease_item_id and hwe.excel_id = hr.excel_id and hr.source_document_category = 'MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_REPORT') as result_id from hls_lease_item hli, prj_project_bp ppb where 1 = 1 and ppb.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id
and ppb.project_id = #{projectId}
and (ppb.bp_role_type = 'MORTGAGOR' or ppb.bp_role_type = 'PLEDGOR')

1=1 and b.bp_type IN ('TENANT', 'ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE', 'ASSET_TRANSFEROR','MANUFACTURER') and b.project_id = #{projectId} and b.bp_categroy = 'PRJ_PROJECT'

SELECT ppb.PRJ_BP_ID, pp.project_id, hli.lease_item_id, hli.lease_item_code, hli.lease_item_code as lease_item_id_n, hli.full_name, hli.full_name as full_name_n, hli.lease_item_type, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'HLS.COLLATERAL_TYPE' and code_value = hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE) LEASE_ITEM_TYPE_N, hli.PATTERN, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code in ('HLS.MORTGAGE_TYPE','HLS.PLEDGE_TYPE') and code_value = hli.PATTERN) PATTERN_N, hli.MORTGAGOR, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = hli.MORTGAGOR) MORTGAGOR_N, hli.VALUATION_UNIT, hli.VALUATION_DATE, (select a.EVALUATION_VALUE from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.EVALUATION_VALUE) as EVALUATION_VALUE from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL, (select a.MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT) as MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) MORTGAGE_AMOUNT_TOTAL, ( select h.excel_id from hls_web_excel h where h.enabled_flag = 'Y' and h.excel_type = 'MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_REPORT') excel_id, ( select max(hr.result_id) from hls_web_excel_calc_result hr where hr.source_document_id = hli.lease_item_id and hr.source_document_category = 'MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_REPORT') result_id, ppb.PLEDGE_PROPORTION, (ppb.PLEDGE_PROPORTION*(select a.MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT) as MORTGAGE_PLEDGE_AMOUNT from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id)) PLEDGE_AMOUNT
FROM prj_project_bp ppb, prj_project pp, hls_lease_item hli
ppb.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id and ppb.project_id = pp.project_id
and pp.project_id = #{projectId}

select nvl(v.CREDIT_AMOUNT, 0) from (select ppb.CREDIT_AMOUNT from prj_project_bp ppb, PRJ_PROJECT pp, CHANGE_REQ_INFO cri where ppb.PROJECT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID and pp.CHANGE_REQ_ID = cri.CHANGE_REQ_ID and cri.STATUS = 'APPROVED' and ppb.BP_ID = #{bpId} order by ppb.CREATION_DATE desc) v where rownum = 1

SELECT hbm.BP_CODE AS bp_code, t.prj_bp_id, t.project_id, t.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_name AS bp_id_n, t.bp_type, t.description, T.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, ( SELECT hba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account hba WHERE hba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = T.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ) BANK_ACCOUNT_ID_N, ( SELECT hba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account hba WHERE hba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = T.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ) BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, ( SELECT hba.BANK_FULL_NAME FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account hba WHERE hba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = T.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID ) BANK_FULL_NAME, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE' AND scv.VALUE = t.bp_type ) bp_type_n, hbm.bp_class, (select hbt.description from hls_business_type hbt where hbm.bp_class = hbt.business_type AND hbt.document_category = 'HLS_BP_MASTER') bp_class_n FROM prj_project_bp t, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE t.bp_id = hbm.BP_ID AND t.project_id=#{projectId} AND t.bp_type IN ( 'TENANT', 'ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE', 'ASSET_TRANSFEROR' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hls_score_calculation fsr WHERE fsr.bp_id = t.bp_id AND fsr.grade_status = 'APPROVED' )
